## Example 1.6 {#ss1-example-1-6}

A sequence is defined such that the $n$th term is given by $a_n=n^2-30$.

a) Is 411 a member of this sequence?

b) If it is, which term of the sequence is it?

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 4 · Example 1.6 · Complete the working in your booklet.</p>

::: notes
Students attempt this independently before discussion. n²−30=411 gives n²=441 and n=±21. Only n=21 is a positive integer, so 411 is the 21st term. Reject −21 because it is outside the index domain. Check a_21=441−30=411.
:::
